issue.subject: BlueStore: online bluefs-bdev-expand leaves new bdev label copies unreserved; object data and label overwrite each other
issue.description:
|Kind|data corruption / data loss (on-disk label and object data)| |Severity|major| |Config|default (@bluestore_bdev_label_multi=true@); needs an online expand (@ceph tell osd.N bluestore bluefs-bdev-expand@) that crosses a label position (1G/10G/100G/1000G)| |Affected|main only: online expand was added by PR #66344 (merged 2026-06-30, a65fd3baf37); not in any release. Reproduced on origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a| |Related|tracker 69997 (label locations found occupied after offline expand in NCB mode; fixed by PR 61843 via the allocator update order). The offline path reserves labels when it re-opens the store; the online path does not| h3. Summary The online branch of @BlueStore::expand_devices()@ writes a new copy of the bdev label at every label position inside the grown range and appends it to @bdev_label_valid_locations@, then hands the whole new range to the allocator with @alloc->init_add_free()@. The label blocks are never reserved, so: # object data can be allocated on a label block and destroy that label copy; # a later label rewrite (@write_meta()@, another online expand) rewrites the label at that location over object data, which then reads back as EIO (csum mismatch). This window lasts until the next restart: at the next mount @_main_bdev_label_try_reserve()@ finds the location occupied and disables it (see Observed); # possibly, with NCB, @_main_bdev_label_remove()@ at umount marks the location free in the allocation file although an object owns it (not exercised by the repro). h3. Root cause @src/os/bluestore/BlueStore.cc@: * 9371-9383: label positions in @[size0, size)@ are pushed to @bdev_label_valid_locations@ and written. * 9406-9410, online branch (@!need_to_close@): @fm->expand(); alloc->expand(); alloc->init_add_free(aligned_size0, aligned_size - aligned_size0);@ with no @init_rm_free()@ for the label blocks. * 7020-7066: @_main_bdev_label_try_reserve()@ is only called from @_open_db_and_around()@ (8082, i.e. mount / fsck / offline expand); the online branch never calls it. h3. Reproduction gtest @MultiLabelTest.OnlineExpandReservesNewLabel@ (@test.cc@; all tests are in "bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/common/patches/bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch): 900M file-backed store; @truncate@ the file to 3G; @expand_devices()@ while mounted; write 400 x 4 MiB objects; check the label at 1G; @write_meta()@; remount; read all objects; fsck. 
ceph_test_objectstore --gtest_filter='*/MultiLabelTest.OnlineExpandReservesNewLabel/*'
h3. Observed (origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a) 
_read_bdev_label .../block data at 0x40000000, unable to decode label
store_test.cc:12330: Failure
  BlueStore::read_bdev_label_at_pos(g_ceph_context, block, _1G, &label)
    Which is: -2
object data overwrote the bdev label at 1G
_main_bdev_label_try_reserve bdev label location 0x40000000 occupied by BlueStore object or BlueFS file, disabling
_verify_csum bad crc32c/0x1000 checksum at blob offset 0xe000, got 0x0, expected 0xe473dc56, device location [0x40000000~1000], logical extent 0x13e000~1000, object #-1:9c8f17dc:::OBJ-248:head#
object OBJ-248 corrupted, read r=-5
objects corrupted by label write
fsck error: bdev label at 0x40000000 corrupted
fsck error:  oid #-1:9c8f17dc:::OBJ-248:head#, extent 0x3fff2000~10000 or a subset is already allocated (misreferenced)
fsck error: leaked extent 0x40000000~1000
  store->fsck(false)
    Which is: 3
h3. Expected The label copy at 1G stays intact, every object reads back, fsck is clean. h3. Suggested fix In the online branch, after @init_add_free()@, reserve each newly added label location (@alloc->init_rm_free(loc, lsize)@), i.e. apply @_main_bdev_label_try_reserve()@ to the new locations. h3. Reproducer files * "test.cc":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/01-online-expand-label-not-reserved/test.cc * Test patch for all gtests: "bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/common/patches/bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch
